description: We are Stellar Minds, a team of six students participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. We are interested in technology, space, and Earth science. Our proposed challenge is The Earth Information Jukebox, where we aim to make NASA's Earth data easier to understand by converting visual information into sound. We welcome teammates interested in coding, web development, audio, design, and data visualization.
summary: EARTHBEAT – Hear Our Planet is an interactive web application developed by Team Stellar Mind X for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. It transforms NASA Earth science data into sound, allowing people to experience changes in our planet in a new way. Using NASA GISTEMP global temperature records and NASA POWER weather data, EARTHBEAT presents climate information through visualizations, timelines, and audio sonification. Users can explore temperature trends and listen to data represented as sound using interactive playback controls. By combining science, technology, and sound, our project aims to make complex Earth data more engaging, understandable, and accessible to a wider audience. EARTHBEAT helps people connect with our planet's changing environment by not only seeing the data, but also hearing it.
details:
EARTHBEAT is an interactive web application that transforms Earth science data into sound, helping users experience our planet's changing environment in a new way.

The website uses NASA GISTEMP global temperature records and NASA POWER daily weather data. It presents information through interactive visualizations, a temperature chart, a timeline, and audio sonification. Users can select sound experiences, play and pause the audio, and explore changes in the data over time.

Our project addresses the challenge "The Earth Information Jukebox" by turning scientific data into an engaging audio experience. Instead of only reading numbers or viewing charts, users can hear patterns represented through sound. This approach can make Earth science more engaging and accessible to different audiences, including people who benefit from alternative ways of experiencing information.

We developed the project using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with browser technologies such as the Web Audio API and Canvas for sound generation and visualization. We also used AI-assisted development tools during coding and project preparation.

The creative idea behind EARTHBEAT is to connect science, sound, and visual storytelling. Our team considered usability, accessibility, data presentation, and making the experience understandable for a broad audience.
